name: perf-ci-heavy-worker-trial
title: Trial two heavy-lane pytest workers on the public runner
description: Trial -n 2 --dist loadfile for the heavy CI lane with measured memory and disk headroom; adopt only at <=12 GB peak memory and >=2 GB free disk.
creator: sdelmas
notes: Run 29798826800 passed the pre-committed decision rule: 5,333,032 KiB peak used memory <= 12,582,912 KiB, 80,632,056 KiB post-run free disk >= 2,097,152 KiB, and 48 heavy tests passed in 500.62s versus the 717s baseline. Adopt two loadfile-distributed heavy workers and remove temporary diagnostics.
